integrity: The conclusion is a symbolic all-parameter proof from the published bound-quiver presentation and standard Brauer-graph relations. No finite computation or unverified classification table is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the representation type only for the explicit Liu--Xin Example 6.3 family. It does not solve Problem 5.4 for arbitrary representation-finite string algebras. The motivating preprint is very recent, so equivalent unindexed observations remain a residual originality risk.
title: A Brauer-tree cover for the nonmonomial endomorphism algebras \(B_m\)
